_comment: Generated once from the official upstream release binaries at https://github.com/AlexxIT/go2rtc/releases/tag/v1.9.14 -- downloaded directly over HTTPS from github.com and hashed immediately, never taken from an installed copy's own --version output or from the AUR package's own checksum file. BackendManager.qml re-verifies a candidate go2rtc binary against these hashes before every single spawn; see README.md's Security > Backend binding section for why this is a committed trust root rather than a check against the installed environment's own metadata.
supportedInstall: AUR go2rtc-bin only -- it ships this exact upstream binary byte-for-byte. AUR go2rtc (built from source with the local toolchain) will not hash-match and is refused by design; see README.md.
